verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an LLM inference API. Its Cloud Console could plausibly surface AI-generated insights on a user's own data, such as usage, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a generic playground and a console for managing keys, usage and billing, with no in-product AI insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. The API primitives (tool calling, structured outputs) are developer building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
